Container.Name: site-manager
Container.Overview:
Site Manager - Admin Interface
Docker-ready CV, resume, and portfolio site management with full editing access. Manage your professional site with an admin UI, persistent SQLite storage, profile picture and media uploads, JSON import/export, page editing, CV profiles, custom CSS, and Cloudflare Access authentication support.
ADMIN VERSION - Full read/write access. Protect this interface with Cloudflare Access, local password authentication, VPN-only access, or another trusted access-control layer.
TIP: Install Site Manager (Public) as a second read-only container on port 3011 if you want a public version. Use the same AppData and Uploads paths in both containers.

Config.Name: Admin WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the admin interface. Keep this internal or protected behind auth/reverse proxy access control.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database storage. IMPORTANT: Use the same path for both Admin and Public containers to share data.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Uploaded images and media. IMPORTANT: Use the same path for both Admin and Public containers.

Config.Name: DB Path
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container. Leave as default unless you know you need a custom path.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required when using password or Cloudflare Access auth. Set to a long random string.

Config.Name: Admin Password Hash
Config.Description: Bcrypt hash of your admin password. Leave blank to disable local password auth.

Config.Name: Trust Cloudflare Access
Config.Description: Set to true if the admin interface is behind Cloudflare Access. Trusts the Cf-Access-Authenticated-User-Email header.

Config.Name: Allowed Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of emails allowed via Cloudflare Access. Leave blank to allow all authenticated Cloudflare Access users.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Set to true when accessed over HTTPS. Recommended for Cloudflare Tunnel setups.

Config.Name: Upload Max MB
Config.Description: Maximum image/media upload size in MB.
